families.page_title: Report an outbreak of acute respiratory infection in an adult social care setting
evidence_points: The service supports reporting of ARI outbreaks in care homes, supported living and extra-care settings.
An outbreak requires 2 or more cases that could be linked by spread within the setting.
Reports include symptom-onset dates, test results and vaccination information.
The online service is available only in specified English regions.
Other regions should use their local health protection or community infection-control reporting route.
UKHSA or community IPC teams use submitted information to assess and support outbreak management.

evidence_points: The code supports registered health and adult social care providers in meeting infection-control registration requirements.
It sets 10 compliance criteria used to assess provider arrangements.
Providers should operate systems to manage and monitor infection prevention and control.

Risk assessment should consider service-user susceptibility and environmental or user-related hazards.

evidence_points: The publication is a rapid systematic review of TB contact-tracing strategies in low-incidence countries.
It examines detection of TB among people exposed to a person with active TB.
The review was commissioned to inform UKHSA operational guidance for health protection teams.
The updated search covered research through November 2025.
No studies matching the review inclusion criteria were identified.
The publication therefore describes the available evidence base and does not itself provide final operational recommendations.
